# Marketing Psychology

Curated by Skill Harbor — a comprehensive marketing-psychology reference in Brazilian Portuguese: fundamental thinking models (first principles, Jobs to Be Done, inversion, Pareto, second-order thinking), buyer psychology (mere exposure, loss aversion, endowment and IKEA effects, zero-price effect, status quo bias, peak-end rule, Zeigarnik), persuasion and influence (reciprocity, commitment, authority, scarcity, foot-in-the-door, anchoring, decoy effect, framing), pricing psychology (charm pricing, round-number fluency, the rule of 100, good-better-best), and design/growth models (Hick's law, AIDA, BJ Fogg, EAST, flywheels, network effects) — each with a concrete marketing application and an ethical-use framing. Includes a quick-reference table mapping challenges (low conversions, price objections, churn) to the relevant models, and companion skills for CRO and copywriting. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @upgrade-php. Honest caveats: Brazilian Portuguese content — the frameworks are universal but the text is PT-BR; a broad survey rather than a deep playbook (dozens of models, one application note each); references companion skills (cro, copywriting) that are not included here. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
